description: Claim a member pass without paying while the free tier is open, for an account whose membership is not active, by a signature from that account (the message and the scheme per rail are in the terms under freeTier.howToClaim). The claim needs a signature, not funds. Configure Authorization: Bearer <pass> in your MCP client and omit the pass argument whenever headers are supported. The pass argument is a sensitive compatibility fallback for clients without header support. Arguments and credential-bearing results, including invoice, claim, free-tier claim and recovery results, may persist in client transcripts. Keep them private. A header takes precedence; conflicting credentials are refused.

account.description: a 0x address, a nano_ account or a base58 Solana address

name: claim_free_tier
